title: Public sewing table
passage: Welcome to the public sewing table. If you need help shortening a curtain, bring a note with the length you want. We don’t need your window measurements. Before we cut anything, we’ll fold the fabric to that length and show you how the bottom edge will look. If the pattern looks odd after folding, we can move the fold and show you another version. You decide which version we make. If you have matching curtains, bring both even if only one needs work. That lets us compare the pattern across the pair before a cut makes the change permanent.
passageZh: 歡迎來到公共縫紉桌。如果需要我們幫忙把窗簾改短，請帶一張便條，寫上你想要的長度。我們不需要你的窗戶尺寸。剪布前會先把布料折到該長度，讓你看底邊的樣子。折起來後圖案若不協調，可以移動折線讓你再看另一個版本。最後做哪一版，由你決定。若是配成一對的窗簾，哪怕只要改一幅，也要把兩幅都帶來。如此才能在不可逆的剪裁前，比對兩幅窗簾的圖案。
